clinical.citation: Widening of the genetic and clinical spectrum of Lamb-Shaffer syndrome, a neurodevelopmental disorder due to SOX5 haploinsufficiency (PMID: 31578471)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: Functional studies showed missense variants in HMG domain prevented SOX5 from binding DNA and promoting transactivation in vitro; variants outside HMG domain did not show this effect

clinical.citation: Lamb-Shaffer syndrome: 20 Spanish patients and literature review expands the view of neurodevelopmental disorders caused by SOX5 haploinsufficiency (PMID: 37702321)

variants.description: Single nucleotide variants (SNVs) - majority in HMG domain

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Haploinsufficiency of SOX5; 83 variants reported across literature; SNVs and CNVs represent 47% and 53% respectively

clinical.citation: Functional characterization of SOX5 variant causing Lamb-Shaffer syndrome and literature review of variants in the SOX5 gene (PMID: 40500800)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: In silico and in vitro data suggest pathogenicity due to reduced transcriptional activation activity; inherited from mother with milder phenotype demonstrating variable expressivity

clinical.citation: Clinical and genetic characterization of a patient with SOX5 haploinsufficiency caused by a de novo balanced reciprocal translocation (PMID: 29477873)

variants.description: de novo balanced reciprocal translocation t(12;20)(p12.1;p12.3) with breakpoint in intron 4 of SOX5

clinical.diagnostic_reason: De novo balanced reciprocal translocation causing SOX5 haploinsufficiency affecting 2 long forms of SOX5; breakpoint confirmed by FISH and nucleotide sequence analysis

clinical.citation: ASHG 2013 - ZBTB20-dependent transcription regulation imbalance in autism and intellectual disability

variants.description: SOX5 disruption by chromosome translocation t(3;12)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: SOX5 identified as downstream target of ZBTB20 transcriptional repressor; mutations associated with ASD and ID; genomic deletions involving SOX5 reported in patients with ASD and/or ID

clinical.citation: ASHG 2009 - Deletion of the SOX5 gene at 12p12.1 is associated with autistic-like behavior and severe language delays

variants.description: Small deletions within SOX5 gene (de novo and inherited)
Larger deletions (5.7, 5.4, 10.5, 8.7 Mb) encompassing complete SOX5 gene

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Deletions of SOX5 represent a microdeletion syndrome; only one deletion found in control population of 5674 samples (in intron); de novo and inherited cases described

model_organism.citation: SOX5 is a candidate gene for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease susceptibility and is necessary for lung development. (PMID: 21330457)
phenotypes: delay in maturation before the saccular stage

model_organism.citation: Xenopus SOX5 enhances myogenic transcription indirectly through transrepression. (PMID: 30071218)
phenotypes: reduced myogenic transcription of muscle markers (Des, Actc1, Ckm, MyhE3)
altered slow muscle-specific gene expression (Myh7L, Myh7S, Myl2, Tnnc1)
impaired antagonism of Meox2 inhibitory function on myogenic differentiation
defective myogenic differentiation during normal development

model_organism.citation: SOX5/6/21 Prevent Oncogene-Driven Transformation of Brain Stem Cells. (PMID: 28687615)
phenotypes: dramatically increased capacity to form glioma-like tumors
increased hyperproliferation of oncogene-expressing SVZ cells
increased tumor formation in oncogene-driven brain tumor model

model_organism.citation: SOX5 postmitotically regulates migration, postmigratory differentiation, and projections of subplate and deep-layer neocortical neurons. (PMID: 18840685)
phenotypes: misrouting of subplate and layer 6 corticothalamic axons to the hypothalamus
abnormal postmitotic differentiation of subplate and deep-layer neurons
maintained immature differentiation state with persistent Fezf2 and Bcl11b expression in layer 6 and subplate neurons

model_organism.citation: Molecular cloning, expression of Sox5 and its down-regulation of Dmrt1 transcription in zebrafish. (PMID: 15981199)

biological.citation: Genome-wide CRISPR activation screening in senescent cells reveals SOX5 as a driver and therapeutic target of rejuvenation (PMID: 37832549)
biological.summary: CRISPRa screening in human mesenchymal precursor cells identified SOX5 as a top hit for antagonizing cellular senescence. SOX5 overexpression resets transcription networks for geroprotective genes including HMGB2 by elevating enhancer activity through increased H3K27ac and H3K4me1 marks. Gene therapy with lentiviruses carrying SOX5 rejuvenated cartilage and alleviated osteoarthritis in aged mice.

biological.citation: Regulation and function of SOX9 during cartilage development and regeneration (PMID: 32380234)
biological.summary: SOX5 functions as part of the chondrogenic SOX Trio (SOX9, SOX5, SOX6) that regulates chondrogenesis in a stage-specific manner. SOX5 works in combination with SOX9 and SOX6 to regulate downstream factors critical for cartilage development and regeneration.

biological.citation: Synovial fibroblasts assume distinct functional identities and secrete R-spondin 2 in osteoarthritis (PMID: 36175067)
biological.summary: Single-cell RNA-sequencing and trajectory analyses identified SOX5 as a potential regulator of the emergence of Prg4hi lining fibroblasts from Dpp4+ mesenchymal progenitors in synovium during post-traumatic osteoarthritis progression.

biological.citation: The role of SOX family members in solid tumours and metastasis (PMID: 30914279)
biological.summary: SOX5 is upregulated in multiple cancer types and associated with poor prognosis. SOX5 is involved in tumorigenesis and cancer progression, including changes in the tumor microenvironment and metastasis.

biological.citation: Integrative functional genomic analysis of human brain development and neuropsychiatric risks (PMID: 30545854)
biological.summary: SOX5 is identified as a gene with genetic associations to brain-based traits and neuropsychiatric disorders. SOX5 converges with other neurodevelopmental genes (MEF2C, SATB2, TCF4, TSHZ3) in specific coexpression modules and distinct cell types during prenatal and postnatal brain development.

biological.citation: GWAS Meta-Analysis of Suicide Attempt: Identification of 12 Genome-Wide Significant Loci and Implication of Genetic Risks for Specific Health Factors (PMID: 37777856)
biological.summary: Multi-ancestry GWAS meta-analysis identified SOX5 as one of the implicated genes at genome-wide significant loci for suicide attempt risk across 43,871 cases and 915,025 controls.

biological.citation: The SoxD transcription factors--Sox5, Sox6, and Sox13--are key cell fate modulators (PMID: 19647094)
biological.summary: SOX5 is a member of the SoxD group of transcription factors with a conserved HMG box DNA-binding domain and group-specific coiled-coil domain mediating protein dimerization. SOX5 redundantly enhances chondrogenesis, hinders melanogenesis, promotes neural crest generation, and controls the pace of neurogenesis. SOX5 enhances transactivation by SOX9 in chondrocytes but antagonizes SOX9 in oligodendrocytes and melanocytes.

biological.citation: Human T-bet governs the generation of a distinct subset of CD11c(high)CD21(low) B cells (PMID: 35867801)
biological.summary: SOX5 was identified as one of the lineage-defining genes whose chromatin accessibility is controlled by T-bet transcription factor in human CD11chiCD21lo B cells, a distinct B cell subset involved in age-associated immune responses.

biological.citation: Residual Breast Cancer Cells Co-opt SOX5-Driven Endochondral Ossification to Maintain Dormancy (PMID: 41370830)
biological.summary: CRISPR-Cas9 screening identified SOX5 as a functional regulator of tumor recurrence in breast cancer. Loss of SOX5 accelerated recurrence and promoted dormancy escape. SOX5 drives dormant residual tumor cells to adopt an endochondral ossification program, a cartilage-dependent bone development pathway that maintains tumor cell dormancy.

biological.citation: Functional characterization of SOX5 variant causing Lamb-Shaffer syndrome and literature review of variants in the SOX5 gene (PMID: 40500800)
biological.summary: SOX5 is a conserved transcription factor with a high-mobility-group domain that enhances expression of extracellular matrix genes by promoting SOX9 binding to distant enhancers. Pathogenic SOX5 missense variants (c.1769T>C, p.Leu590Ser) show reduced transcriptional activation activity, causing Lamb-Shaffer syndrome characterized by intellectual disability, seizures, autism, and developmental delay.

biological.citation: ASHG 2022 - Genome-wide association meta-analysis reveals 99 risk loci for pain susceptibility and pleiotropic relationships with psychiatric, metabolic, and immunological traits (E. Mocci, K. Ward, S. Dorsey, S. Ament)
biological.summary: Meta-analysis of 17 pain susceptibility traits identified SOX5 at locus 12p12.1 as significantly associated with back pain (P-value 3.56e-11), driven primarily by the back pain phenotype.
